name: Mafu a letlalo a bakoang ke fungus
tagline: Leoto la moatlelete, seboko, jock itch. Theko e tlaase ho phekola.
reviewer: Ho hlahloba ha tleliniki ho ntse ho emetse

what_is_it.heading: Tšoaetso ea fungal letlalong ka mantsoe a hlakileng
what_is_it.lede: Tšoaetso ea letlalo la fungal e bakoa ke li-fungus tse nyenyane tse se nang kotsi tse phelang likarolong tse futhumetseng, tse mongobo tsa 'mele. Ha li hola ho feta tekano, li baka ho hlohlona, ​​makhopho, hangata a bōpehileng joaloka lesale. E tena empa ka kakaretso ho bonolo ho e phekola.
paragraphs: Mefuta e tloaelehileng: leoto la moatlelete (pakeng tsa menoana), jock itch (groin), ringworm (kae kapa kae - ha e le hantle fungus, eseng seboko), fungus ea manala, seboko sa letlalo ho bana. Leha ho na le mabitso a fapaneng, kaofela a bakoa ke li-fungus tse tšoanang.

Ba bangata ba arabela ka tranelate ea antifungal e sebelisoang bakeng sa libeke tse 2-4. Tse ling - li-fungus tsa manala, tšoaetso ea letlalo la hlooho - li hloka matlapa a lengolo la ngaka. Batho ba nang le lefu la tsoekere, tsamaiso ea 'mele ea ho itšireletsa mafung e fokolang, kapa HIV ba ka 'na ba fumana tšoaetso e matla le ho feta kapa khafetsa.

facts.heading: Lintho tse 'nè tseo u lokelang ho li tseba

items.headline: E tloaelehileng haholo
items.body: Leoto la moatlelete feela le ama batho ba baholo ba fihlang ho 70% ka nako e itseng. Li-Ringworm le jock itch li atile lefatšeng ka bophara.

items.headline: Ho bonolo ho phekola
items.body: Bongata ba mafu a fungal letlalong lea hlaka ka tranelate e rekisoang ka mor'a libeke tse 2-4. E theko e tlase, e fumaneha khemisi efe kapa efe.

items.headline: E a tshwaetsana
items.body: Li-fungus li hasana holim'a lithaole, mabatong a shaoara, limmete tsa boikoetliso, lieta tse arolelanoang. E phekole - 'me u se ke ua arolelana lithaole kapa lieta nakong ea phekolo.

items.headline: Boloka o omme
items.body: Fungus e rata letlalo le futhumetseng le le mongobo. Omisa ka ho feletseng ka mor'a ho itlhatsoa, ​​fetola likausi tse fufuleloa le liaparo tsa ka tlaase, u ntše lieta. Thibelo hangata e mabapi le ho omella.

pull_quote.text: Haeba 'lesale' letlalong le sa hlake ka tranelate ea antifungal ka libeke tse 4, bona ngaka. Maemo a mang a letlalo a shebahala joalo ka seboko - 'me tranelate ea steroid e tla mpefatsa seboko sa 'nete.
pull_quote.source: Mokhatlo oa Dermatological of South Africa

signs.heading: Mekhoa e tloaelehileng
signs.lede: Tšoaetso ea fungal kaofela e na le chebahalo e hlohloneng, ea makhopho, hangata e nang le sebopeho sa lesale - empa moo e hlahang teng ea fapana.

items.title: Leoto la moatlelete
items.description: Ho hlohlona, ​​ho phunyeha, ho phunya letlalo pakeng tsa menoana - haholo-holo ea 4 le ea 5. E ka hasana ho soles. Monko. E mpefala hlabula le lieta tse fufuleloa.

items.title: Seboko (tinea corporis)
items.description: Bofubelu bo pota-potileng (kapa bo lefifi, letlalong le Letšo) patch ea scaly e nang le setsi se hlakileng - se shebahala joaloka lesale. Butle-butle e hola ka ntle. E tloaelehileng matsohong, molala, 'mele. Ho hlohlona.

items.title: Jock itch le letlalo la hlooho
items.description: Jock itch: bofubelu, lekhopho le hlabang ka mameno a groin - le tloaelehileng ho banna, ka mor'a ho fufuleloa. Seboko sa letlalo la hlooho: ho lahleheloa ke moriri o mosoeu ka sekhahla - ho tloaelehile ho bana, ho hloka matlapa.

spreads.heading: Mokhoa oa ho ata ha mafu a fungal
yes: Ho kopana ka ho toba letlalong le letlalo le motho ea tšoaelitsoeng
Lithaole tse arolelanoang, line ea bethe, liaparo, borashe ba moriri
Ho tsamaea u sa roala lieta mekatong e silafetseng - lishaoara tsa sechaba, likamore tsa ho fetola boikoetliso ba 'mele, matamo a ho sesa
Lieta tse arolelanoang, haholo-holo lisebelisoa tsa lipapali
Ho tsoa ho liphoofolo tse ruuoang lapeng (likatse le lintja li ka jara liboko)
Ho tloha lisebelisoa tsa mofufutso libakeng tsa boikoetliso kapa lipapali
no: Ho kopana feela joalo ka ho tsukutla matsoho kapa ho haka
Ho ba ka phaposing e le nngwe

prevention.heading: Mokhoa oa ho qoba ho e fumana hape
prevention.lede: Fungus e khutla haeba maemo a lula a futhumetse ebile a le mongobo. Mekhoa e menyenyane ea letsatsi le letsatsi e thibela ho pheta-pheta hangata.

items.title: Omella hantle ka mor'a ho hlatsoa
items.description: Haholo-holo pakeng tsa menoana, ka groin, tlas'a matsoele, ka mameno a letlalo. Pat omisa. Letlalo le omeletseng ke lehae le se nang botsoalle bakeng sa li-fungus.

items.title: K'hothone e hloekileng, fetola hangata
items.description: Likausi tsa k'hothone le liaparo tsa kahare li phefumoloha hantle ho feta li-synthetics. Fetola letsatsi le letsatsi le ka mor'a ho fufuleloa. U se ke ua boela ua apara liaparo tsa boikoetliso tse mofufutso.

items.title: U se ke ua tsamaea u sa roala lieta pontšeng
items.description: Lishaoara tsa sechaba, likamore tsa ho fetola boikoetliso ba 'mele, libaka tsa matamo a ho sesa - roala meqathatso kapa meqathatso. Bongata ba mafu a maoto a fungal a tsoa libakeng tsena.

items.title: U se ke ua arolelana lithaole kapa lieta
items.description: Esita le litho tsa lelapa. Haeba motho a e-na le tšoaetso ea fungal, sebelisa lithaole tse arohaneng ho fihlela e hlakotsoe.

action_steps.heading: Se o lokelang ho se etsa

items.title: Qala ho reka tranelate ea antifungal
items.description: Clotrimazole kapa terbinafine - sebelisa habeli ka letsatsi sebakeng se amehileng hammoho le 2cm ho potoloha. Tsoela pele ho qeta libeke tse 2 ka mor'a hore lekhopho le hlakole ho thibela ho khutla.

items.title: Boloka sebaka se omme 'me se pepesehile moeeng
items.description: U se ke ua tlamisa. Apara liaparo tse hlephileng. Letlalo le hema. Phofo (eseng tranelate) hoseng e ka thusa ho groin kapa maotong bakeng sa ho monya mofufutso.

items.title: Tšoara mohloli
items.description: Hlatsoa lithaole tsohle, libethe le liaparo tse ammeng tšoaetso ka metsi a chesang. Lahla kapa u bolaee lieta tsa khale haeba leoto la moatlelete le lula le khutla.

items.title: Haeba ho se betere libeke tse 4 - bona ngaka
items.description: Maemo a mang a shebahalang a tšoana ha a arabele ho antifungal. Li-fungus tsa manala le seboko sa letlalo la hlooho li hloka matlapa. Litliliniki tsa mmuso li fana ka bobeli mahala.

items.title: Haeba u na le lefu la tsoekere kapa HIV - tsamaea kapele
items.description: Tšoaetso ea fungal e ka ba matla le ho feta 'me ea ata ka potlako. E-ea tleliniking ka lets'oao la pele - u se ke oa emela ho leka ho ea lebenkeleng ka libeke.

get_help.heading: Moo u ka eang teng
get_help.lede: Bongata ba mafu a letlalo a fungal bo hlapolla ka tranelate e theko e tlaase. Haeba li sa etse joalo, litliliniki tsa 'muso li fana ka phekolo ea mahala ea ngaka.

helplines.name: Khemisi efe kapa efe ea lehae
helplines.description: Litlolo tsa antifungal tse rekisoang - clotrimazole, terbinafine
helplines.meta: Ha ho lengolo la ngaka le hlokahalang bakeng sa tranelate

helplines.name: Fumana tleliniki e haufi le uena
helplines.description: Tlhahlobo ea mahala le phekolo ea meriana ea antifungal haeba ho hlokahala
helplines.meta: Ha ho kopano · ha ho hlokahale thuso ea bongaka
